type ReadonlyString = readonly string;
type ReadonlyGeneric = readonly Array<number>;
type RequiredAfterOptional = [number?, string];
type MultipleRest = [...number[], ...string[]];
type OptionalAfterRest = [...number[], string?];
type MultipleConcreteWithGeneric<T extends unknown[], U extends unknown[]> = [...T, ...number[], ...U, ...string[]];
type NestedConcreteRest = [...[number, ...string[]], ...boolean[]];
type UnconstrainedRest<T> = [...T];
